_about: «الحملات» dashboard: the WhatsApp campaigns scheduled in Hatif (Hatif has no campaign API, so this list is the mirror). No phone numbers here, ever. $STATE_DIR/campaign_board.json wins over this file when it parses. Rates: 'expect' = the plan's low/mid/high share of people who book (owners: who sign a unit); 'baseline' = the share who book in the same window with NO message, back-tested on the Hostaway backup Mar–Oct 2026 with each group's own selection rule; 'value' = the average booking value for that group in the same back-test (owners: Ouja's monthly fee per unit).
